content: मध्य {%a.%} [मन्-यत् नस्य धः <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 Middle, central, being in the middle or centre; एकं मुक्तागुणमिव भुवः स्थूलमध्येन्द्रनीलम् <ls>Me. 48</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 21</ls>. .²2 Intervening, intermediate. .²3 Middling, moderate, of a middling size or quality, mediocre; अग्र्यो मध्यो जघन्यश्च तं प्रवेक्ष्याम्यशेषतः <ls>Ms. 12. 30</ls>; प्रारभ्य विध्नविहता विरमन्ति मध्याः <ls>Bh. 2. 27</ls>. .²4 Neutral, impartial. .²5 Just, right. .²6 Mean (in <ab>astr.</ab>). .{@-ध्यः, -ध्यम्@} .²1 The middle, centre, middle or central part; अह्नः मध्यम् mid-day; सहस्रदीधितिरलंकरोति मध्यमह्नः <ls>Māl.</ls> .²1 ‘the sun is on the meridian’ or ‘right over-head’; सरति सहसा बाह्वोर्मध्यं गताप्यबला सती <ls>M. 4. 11</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>); व्योममध्ये <ls>V. 2. 1</ls>. .²2 The middle of the body, the waist; मध्ये क्षाम <ls>Me. 84</ls>; वेदिविलग्नमध्या <ls>Ku. 1. 39</ls>; विशालवक्षास्तनुवृत्तमध्यः <ls>R. 6. 32</ls>; दधाना बलिभं मध्यं कर्णजाहविलोचना <ls>Bk. 4. 16</ls>. .²3 The belly, abdomen; मध्येन … वलित्रयं चारु बभार बाला <ls>Ku. 1. 39</ls>. .²4 The inside or interior of anything. .²5 A middle state or condition. .²6 The flank of a horse. .²7 Mean time in music. .²8 The middle term of a progression. .²9 Cessation, pause, interval. .{@-ध्या@} .²1 The middle finger. .²2 A young woman, one arrived at puberty. .{@-ध्यम्@} Ten thousand billions. [The <ab>acc.</ab>, <ab>instr.</ab>, <ab>abl.</ab> and <ab>loc.</ab> singulars of मध्य are used adverbially. .³({%a%}) मध्यम् into the midst of, into. .³({%b%}) मध्येन through or between. .³({%c%}) मध्यात् out of, from among, from the midst (with <ab>gen.</ab>); तेषां मध्यात् काकः प्रोवाच <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .³({%d%}) मध्ये .²1 in the middle, between, among, in the midst; स जहार तयोर्मध्ये मैथिलीं लोकशोषणः <ls>R. 12. 29</ls>. .²2 in, into, within, inside, oft, as the first member of adverbial compounds; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} मध्येगङ्गम् into the Ganges; मध्येजठरम् in the belly; <ls>Bv. 1. 61</ls>; मध्येनगरम् inside the city; मध्येनदि in the middle of the river; मध्येपृष्ठम् on the back; मध्येभक्तम् a medicine taken in the middle of oneʼs meals; मध्येरणम् in the battle; <ls>Bv. 1. 128</ls>; मध्येसभम् in or before an assembly; <ls>N. 6. 76</ls>; मध्येसमुद्रम् in the midst of the sea; <ls>Śi. 3. 33.</ls>].
